<CHAR 5,0,7,0,8><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,37>Ah, you've come.
Forgive me, but may I start at once?

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 10>This hunting request I'm about to give —
I want you two to take the vanguard.

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 10>In the Isles there are monsters
our hunts have never reached.

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 10>Mm. Monsters dwelling in the island's
most rugged areas — left alone
for their devilish strength.

Now the hunters' ranks are full,
so the time is ripe; we've decided
to proceed with the hunt.

<CV 5,1>I'd like you to lead the hunt.
The guild will repay you with its
deepest thanks and a 「special title」.

What matters is not strength,
but a 「proud soul」.

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,1><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,20>Oho, you'll take it on!
Splendid! Do your best!

「Hunting is fun because of the thrill」 —
isn't that so!
